config firewall policy
    edit 220061
        set status disable
        set name "netops-g22-first"
        set uuid 00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001
        set srcintf "dmz"
        set dstintf "wan2"
        set action accept
        set srcaddr "netops-g22-src"
        set dstaddr "netops-g22-dst"
        set schedule "always"
        set service "HTTPS"
        set logtraffic all
    next
